verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents an official, optional Docker-based setup and onboarding guide. Its install page lists an installer script, npm/pnpm/bun, from-source and Docker paths, and remote-access docs cover reaching a Gateway running elsewhere over SSH tunnels or Tailscale. That only covers one of the four named targets with a dedicated guide. Missing for 10: an explicit Docker Compose guide, a Kubernetes/Helm deployment guide, a dedicated small-VPS deployment guide, a Raspberry Pi guide, and any evidence that these guides are maintained or independently corroborated.
